//: Helmion Voice Dictation. Edit this file, then restart the app (stop-dictation.ps1 then start-dictation.ps1). Nothing here is compiled in.
//hotkey: Press once to start recording, press again to stop, transcribe and inject. Modifiers: ctrl, alt, shift, win. Chosen default avoids Grok Build's ctrl+space and F8 — RegisterHotKey matches modifiers EXACTLY, so ctrl+alt+space never steals plain ctrl+space.
//cancelHotkey: Throws away the current recording without transcribing or typing anything. Leave empty to disable.
//conversationHotkey: HANDS-FREE MODE. Press once and every finished Claude Code reply is read aloud by the local Kokoro voice. Press again and it stops talking THIS INSTANT — it cuts the sentence playing and drops anything queued behind it. Leave empty to disable the key and toggle with voice.ps1 -Conversation instead.
//voiceStateFile: The file the Claude Code Stop hook checks before it speaks. Empty = C:\Users\troyh\.claude\voice_enabled.txt, which is the path that hook already reads. Only change this if the hook changes too.
//speakExePath: Empty = find 'Helmion Voice Speak.exe' by walking up from this exe to the sibling Helmion.VoiceSpeak\bin folder. Set it only if the speaker lives somewhere else.
//injectionMode: 'paste' = set clipboard then send ctrl+v (fast, exact, any length). 'type' = synthesise the characters with SendInput unicode events (works where there is no paste keybinding, e.g. some remote/legacy consoles).
//restoreClipboard: With injectionMode 'paste', put whatever was on the clipboard back after pasting.
//appendTrailingSpace: Add one space after the injected text so consecutive dictations do not run together.
//autoSubmit: false = text lands in the prompt and Troy presses Enter himself. Leave this false: true would send dictated text to Claude with no chance to fix a mis-hear.
//maxRecordingSeconds: Hard stop so a forgotten hotkey cannot record forever.
//modelPath: Empty = resolve automatically: HELMION_VOICE_MODELS env var, then models/ beside the exe, then walk up to desktop/models/ggml-base.en.bin.
//showTrayIcon: Small coloured dot near the clock: grey idle, red recording, amber transcribing, dark red error. No console, no taskbar entry, no popups.
//vocabulary: THE POINT OF THIS TOOL. These words are fed to Whisper as an initial prompt so it stops turning 'Helmion' into 'Helmand' and 'Moshi' into 'Moshe'. Add your own freely — one string per term. Whisper only reads the LAST ~224 tokens of the prompt, and later terms carry more weight, so if this list ever gets very long, put the words that matter most at the END.
//vocabularyPromptOverride: Advanced. Non-empty replaces the generated prompt entirely with this exact text. Leave empty to let the vocabulary list above build it.
